Simeon Chow is an assistant professor of marketing at Boston University. He is a graduate of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. He received his M.B.A. from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania and his Ph.D. from the Sloan School of Management at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. His research interests are decision support systems for management of advertising, new product development, and statistical and measurement methods in marketing and survey research. His other interests include motorcycles, old cars, and anything high-tech. While involvement and brand loyalty are two research topics, he seems to avoid both in his own life
